text:
nina: Heads-up 1 NeonFlux case write-up ready for final approvals. Theyve greenlit the narrative but want localized copy for FR/JP and a short video clip of the CTO. Can legal confirm quote release + logo use by Thu EOD? Were targeting the webinar + publish on Jun 10.
omar: Link the draft pls. I'll scope the social pack and press post.
omar: https://docs.google.com/neonflux-case-draft (bottom has proposed headlines & tweet text)
rachel: Legal checks 1 paste the exact quote they want to run and if there's any co-marketing restrictions. We need explicit permission to translate the quote.
nina: Proposed quote from NeonFlux CPO: "With Redwood, our inference p95 latency dropped by roughly 55%, and inference unit cost fell by nearly half, which unlocked faster feature rollouts."
sam: Ops ask 1 webinar timing: Jun 8 09:00 UTC or Jun 9 16:00 JST (to suit APAC). Pref Jun 9 for APAC attendance.
yvonne: I'll own localization. Confirming NeonFlux is ok with translated versions and that they will review FR/JP copies. Need permission to publish localized quotes.
hugo: Design will make a neutral hero slide and short one-pager. Want logo svg, headshot, and a 1-paragraph customer blurb for the case header. Also prefer a 10s video clip soundbite from the CTO.
ops-bot: Routing note 1 lead form hidden_field=campaign=neonflux_case, route leads to APAC_AE and EMEA_inbound; tag @omar for demo follow-up.
rachel: Legal: redlines for the quote - change 'roughly 55%' -> 'approximately 55%'; change 'nearly half' -> 'approximately 50%'. Also require a short written release: "NeonFlux grants Redwood permission to publish the quote, logo, and translated versions on or after the agreed publish date." Need that email by Thu EOD.
nina: I'll request the release and ask permission for translations + 10s CTO clip. Also confirm no raw revenue/MRR will be included.
omar: Small copy tweak: headline option A: 'Speeding inference, lowering costs: NeonFlux at scale' or option B: 'How NeonFlux cut p95 latency and inference expense'. Which is less customer-specific pre-approval?
yvonne: Use the neutral one (A) until logo approved, we can swap in brand assets after sign-off.
hugo: Video capture plan: remote 1080p record, ask CTO for the 10s line: "Redwood cut our p95 latency by ~55% and halved inference cost." We'll stitch and mute background. Need release to embed clip on landing page.
ops-bot: Calendar check 1 NeonFlux CTO availability: Jun 2 14:00 CEST or Jun 3 08:00 JST. Which works for design + recording?
sam: Jun 3 08:00 JST fits APAC recording slot. I'll lock the webinar to Jun 9 16:00 JST and set a rehearsals session Jun 4.
rachel: Also flagging any quotes claiming regulatory or compliance implications need extra proof. This one looks fine. Once email release includes 'translated versions' and 'video clip embedding', legal can sign.
nina: I've emailed NeonFlux comms asking for: svg logo, headshot, email release with publish date Jun 10, and translation permission by Thu EOD.
yvonne: I'll prep FR/JP drafts and post them in the folder for review when release arrives.
omar: I'll draft the social copy and webinar CTAs. Ops, please ensure leads map to SF campaign NEON-06-2026.
ops-bot: Mapping set 1 campaign=NEON-06-2026, lead owner rule=APAC_ldrs then round-robin EMEA.
hugo: Checklist: 1) Email release + translation permission (nina) 2) Assets (logo/headshot/video clip) (neonflux) 3) Legal sign-off (rachel) 4) Localized copy (yvonne) 5) Slides + one-pager (hugo) 6) Landing page + lead routing (ops) 7) Webinar Jun 9, publish Jun 10.
calendar-bot: Event created 1 "NeonFlux webinar: Inference at scale" Jun 9 16:00 JST 1 invites: nina,omar,yvonne,hugo,sam,rachel
rachel: On standby. If we receive the release by Thu EOD, legal can clear the case for Jun 10 publish.
nina: Thanks everyone 1 will update thread when they reply. :raised_hands:
